judge.rationale: The candidate's implementation is completely sound and satisfies every acceptance criterion, including summing usage across a turn with two tool rounds (three provider calls), handling rounds without usage metadata, and preserving backwards compatibility. In `chatOrchestrator.ts`, the candidate uses the exact same seam and accumulation logic as the reference (`totalUsage` local, `sumUsage` helper, and `totalUsage` parameter name in `OrchestratorHooks`). The candidate additionally introduces a `TotalUsageMetadata = UsageMetadata` type alias in `src/types/ai.ts` (which the issue's key files and acceptance criteria hinted at), whereas the reference only renamed the hook parameter. Minor divergences from the reference include placing the new tests in separate test files rather than extending `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, updating the bullet in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` in-place rather than moving it out of the 'out of scope' section, and omitting doc updates in `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`.
